cases.message: Get a second opinion from Gemini web on the caching trade-offs in docs/rfc-cache.md before I finalize it.

files.docs/rfc-cache.md:
# RFC: Read-through cache

Proposal: cache product catalog lookups in Redis with a 5-minute TTL and invalidation on catalog publish events.
Trade-offs: stale reads during publish lag vs lower Postgres read load.

cases.judge: Calls scripts/gemini_web.py with the clean content of docs/rfc-cache.md in a temporary chat, from the main session without a subagent, and prints no cookie.
